usage: The word 電視 (din6 si6) refers to the TV or television set used for watching shows and news.
You can use 電視 as a subject or object in a sentence, for example, 'The TV is on' or 'I watch TV every day.'
It is often paired with verbs like 睇 (tai2, to watch), 開 (hoi1, to turn on), or 關 (gwaan1, to turn off).
You can also use 電視 to talk about different programs or channels on TV, e.g., 'There are many movies on TV tonight.'
